title: Free Dictionary API (Wiktionary data, no API key)
offer_detail: A free public dictionary API built on Wiktionary data. No API key is required to use it. It provides dictionary/word lookup endpoints for developers.
value_desc: Free API access to Wiktionary dictionary data (no API key, no stated cost)
requirements: No API key required. Rate limits, uptime, and long-term availability are not stated and should be verified. Suitable for developers needing dictionary lookups.
steps: Open the API documentation at https://api.suvankar.cc/docs/dictionary
Review the available endpoints and request format
Call the API directly without an API key
risk_warning: This is a small community-hosted API; reliability, rate limits, data accuracy, and longevity are not guaranteed. Do not rely on it for production-critical services without verification.
